exposure: 4-French aortic balloon inflated during cesarean hysterectomy
4-French sheath placed without balloon inflation during cesarean hysterectomy
No sheath placement during cesarean hysterectomy
cohort: The study included 81 patients with histopathologically confirmed placenta increta or percreta who underwent cesarean hysterectomy at a single tertiary care center.
finding: Inflation of a 4-French aortic occlusion balloon during cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum was associated with lower blood loss and fewer units of blood transfused, but also longer operative times, compared with no sheath placement.
